svg.title: News Feed System — Hybrid Fan-Out Architecture & 5-Layer Cache Hierarchy
svg.desc: Comprehensive architecture of a high-throughput news feed system showing feed publishing, graph lookup, privacy cache filter, Kafka fan-out workers, bounded news feed cache, celebrity fan-out-on-read heap merge, and the ByteByteGo 5-layer cache topology.
svg.text: News Feed System — Hybrid Fan-Out Architecture & 5-Layer Cache Hierarchy
Post Publishing · Graph DB & Privacy Filter · Kafka Fan-Out Pipeline · Bounded Cache · Celebrity Heap Merge · 5-Layer Cache Topology
Stores post in Sharded DB & L2
Query Graph DB / TAO L3 cache
Post text & media from Content L2
ByteByteGo 5-Layer Cache Architecture — Sub-10ms Timeline Delivery & Component Isolation
